answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity must burn a unique puzzle costing ~500 CPU-hours (~$12 at spot rates). A spiral difficulty schedule raises this cost superlinearly as identifiers cluster on one fingerprint. Yarrow hashes seed per-epoch salts, so precomputed work invalidates and must be redone. Copper-level hardware offers no shortcut—ASIC gains cap at 3x. Farming 1,000 sybils costs ~$36k plus wasted rework, exceeding any airdrop value. Works because marginal identity cost stays above marginal reward, killing the farm economics.
